examples.text: Мы построим кластер. Это тысячи рабочих мест.
examples.trans: We will build the cluster. That means thousands of jobs.

meanings.note: Exclamation of amazement. Core Russian interj meaning 'wow, oof' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ух ты! Как ты это сделал?
examples.trans: Wow! How did you do that?
Oof, what heat!

examples.text: Да, мой топор. Ух ты! Как ты это сделал?
examples.trans: Yes, my axe. Wow! How did you do that?

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('good, nice').

examples.trans: A good day.
What a lovely morning!

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

meanings.note: Question word. Core Russian pron meaning 'what' in everyday speech.
Conjunction. Core Russian pron meaning 'what' in everyday speech.
Core Russian pron meaning 'what' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: What's this?
Look what I've got.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
examples.trans: Hi! Look what I've got.

meanings.en: a little bit, just a little
meanings.note: Core Russian adv meaning 'a little bit, slightly' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Нам нужно чуть-чуть потерпеть и немножко поработать.
examples.trans: We need to be patient a little and work a bit.
Wait just a little bit longer.

examples.text: Послушай меня, Ваня. Нам нужно чуть-чуть потерпеть и немножко поработать.
examples.trans: Listen to me, Vanya. We need to be patient a little and work a bit.

meanings.note: Of a building. Common masculine noun meaning 'floor, storey' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: У нас ведь второй этаж, да?
examples.trans: Ours is the second floor, right?
They live on the third floor.

examples.text: У нас ведь второй этаж, да? Давай, слушаем.
examples.trans: Ours is the second floor, right? Go on, let's listen.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine
Linking word: главное — это народ. Core Russian pron meaning 'this, that; it is' in everyday speech.

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'this, that; it is' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: That's mine.
And this is for you.
And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: меня = me (genitive/accusative), мне = to me (dative)

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'I' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: I'm doing my homework.
I grew up here.
Chef, I didn't take it.
